{{Quote|Hmmm... slaur roe fresh from the swamp. Tickles the throat, it does, and the belly it fills.|Luke Skywalker gives an impression of Yoda speaking about slaur roe|<ref name="Ab" />}}
'''Slaur roe''' was a type of [[Egg/Legends|roe]] that could be found in the [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] of<ref name="Ab" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]]. It could be [[Diet/Legends|eaten]] by members of<ref name="Ab" /> exiled [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]]<ref name="TEA" /> [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda's]] [[Yoda's species/Legends|species]]. Yoda claimed that it filled his [[Stomach/Legends|belly]] but tickled his [[Throat/Legends|throat]]. When the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] trained with Yoda on Dagobah, the Grand Master made him eat slaur roe as well. When Skywalker's [[Gender/Legends|son]], [[Ben Skywalker]], complained about the smell of the unwashed bodies of the group known as the [[Mind Walkers]] on [[Sinkhole Station]]<ref name="Ab" /> in [[43 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]'' to [[43 ABY]].</ref> Luke told him that Yoda had made him eat things that smelt worse than their current situation and did an impression of the Grand Master speaking about slaur roe.<ref name="Ab" />

==Behind the scenes==
Slaur roe was mentioned in the [[2009]] novel ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]'', which was written by [[Troy Denning]] as the third installment of the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series.<ref name="Ab" />
